card_title: My Never-Paste List (and How to Use Private Chats)
card_desc: What I never paste into ChatGPT or Claude, what to do instead, and how to start a private chat in both.
meta_title: What Never to Paste Into ChatGPT or Claude (Free List) | Olivia Porter
meta_description: My never-paste list for AI chats: passwords, financial and tax ID numbers, client names in contracts, and employee HR details. What to do instead, how to use private chats in ChatGPT and Claude, and what to do if you paste something by mistake.
sub: If you wouldn't put it on a billboard, don't put it in your chat.
intro: Here's my never-paste list, plus what to do instead so you still get the help you need.

steps.title: Passwords and logins
steps.text: That includes API keys, Wi-Fi passwords, and the shared login sitting in your team doc. If a task needs a login, do that part yourself.

steps.title: Bank, card and tax ID numbers
steps.text: Account numbers, card numbers, Social Security numbers and EINs. Need help with a statement or an invoice? Delete or black out the numbers first. The AI doesn't need them to help.

steps.title: Client names in contracts
steps.text: Swap in Client A, Client B before you paste. To change every name at once, use Find and replace: in Google Docs it's under Edit, and in Word it's Replace on the Home tab.

steps.title: Employee health or HR details
steps.text: Medical information, performance problems, pay disputes, or anything from a personnel file. Need help with a hard HR email? Describe the situation without names or health details.

steps.title: The billboard check
steps.text: Run through these before you hit paste:
list: Would I be okay if this showed up on a billboard?
Can I swap the names for Client A or Employee B?
Can I delete the numbers and still get the help I need?

sections.label: Private chats
sections.title: How to turn on private chats

steps.title: In ChatGPT: Temporary chat
steps.text: Open a new chat and select Temporary. Then choose Personalized (uses your memory and custom instructions) or Unpersonalized (uses neither) before your first message.
list: It stays out of your chat history unless you save it.
It isn't used to train models while it stays temporary, and it never creates memories.
OpenAI may keep a copy for up to 30 days for safety.

steps.title: In Claude: Incognito chat
steps.text: Start a new chat (outside a project) and click the ghost icon in the upper right corner. You'll see a black border and an Incognito chat label.
list: It isn't saved to your chat history or Claude's memory.
It isn't used to train models, even if you've turned that setting on.
Anthropic keeps it for 30 days by default. Once you close it, you can't reopen it.

steps.title: Pasted something by mistake?
steps.text: Delete the chat right away. Both companies say deleted chats are removed from their systems within 30 days, with a few exceptions.
list: ChatGPT: click ••• next to the chat, then Delete, and confirm.
Claude: hover over the chat in the sidebar, click ⋮, then Delete, and confirm.
If it was a password, change that password now.

steps.title: Turn off training for every chat
steps.text: Private chats are for one-offs. To keep all your chats out of training, switch it off in your settings. My ChatGPT settings guide shows where, and covers Claude too.

link.text: See the 5 ChatGPT settings to change

closing: A private chat still isn't the place for anything on the never-paste list. My rule: if you wouldn't put it on a billboard, don't put it in your chat.
